# Pataditas

> Pataditas is a private baby kick counter and pregnancy journal for iPhone and Apple Watch, made by Kaelux in Mexico. You tap whenever your baby moves; there is no session to start or stop, and the app groups your taps and notes when 10 movements have been logged within 2 hours. No account, no ads, no tracking. Pataditas is not a medical device and cannot tell whether a baby is well.

## Key facts

- Platforms: iPhone (iOS 26 or later) and a companion Apple Watch app (watchOS 26 or later). Current version: 1.1, live on the App Store.
- Languages (11): English, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, German, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Dutch and Albanian.
- Core features: one-tap movement logging (kick, roll or hiccup), 24-hour timeline, contraction timer, Apple Watch app with complications, widgets, Live Activity, Siri and Control Center quick logging, daily reminder, PDF report for your doctor (Pataditas Plus) that includes 2-hour counting moments.
- Privacy: no account. Data stays on your iPhone and in your own private iCloud (CloudKit); the developer cannot see it. Anonymous usage statistics are optional (opt-in) and off by default.
- Pricing: counting is free. Pataditas Plus (pattern charts, full history, PDF report) has a 7-day free trial; Pregnancy Pass is a one-time purchase. Prices vary by country; purchases are handled by Apple.
- Medical stance: Pataditas records what you feel; it does not diagnose anything and its 10-in-2-hours grouping is not a health assessment. If your baby moves less than usual, stops moving or the pattern changes, contact your doctor, midwife or maternity unit immediately.
